nodes.label: AiNode
nodes.rationale: ИИ — необязательный шаг: для типовых сценариев хватает кнопок и условий, подключать его стоит там, где клиент пишет произвольным текстом.

nodes.label: Builder({ go })
nodes.rationale: On mobile the bottom sheet covers the lower part of the stage, so the selected block is re-centred into the upper quarter of the viewport.

nodes.label: Funnel block types (start, message, condition, action, ai, booking, handoff, note)
dayInfo(date, S, bookings, service, format, now)
nodes.rationale: Server computes slots the same way: rules → closed days → Google Calendar → existing bookings → daily limits, so the client-side preview matches backend availability.

nodes.label: MonthGrid({ cursor, setCursor, cell, onPick, selected })
WidgetTab
nodes.rationale: Presents the client-facing booking form (site and Telegram bot) whose free slots are computed from the schedule settings, so the admin can preview exactly what the client sees.

nodes.label: Composer
nodes.rationale: The composer explains to the user that the agent will first draw up a plan and do nothing until that plan is approved.

nodes.label: AgentPage
nodes.rationale: Agent acts only on an approved plan; the step executor simulates two ticks per step (start → done) because in the production version this is a server-side queue. Execution halts before a danger step until the user explicitly confirms.

nodes.label: makePlan
nodes.rationale: In the production version the plan is authored by Claude (Opus) from the task text, attachments and the knowledge base; in this prototype it is a keyword-based mock.

nodes.label: RISK (step risk levels)
nodes.rationale: Danger-level steps are labelled "only with your confirmation" — irreversible actions require explicit user approval.

hyperedges.label: Agent task lifecycle: plan → approval → execution → report
